verdict: The auxiliary demonstrably trained; no evidence of task improvement. This v3 run had worse training diagnostics than v2 under different task distributions.
source: comparison.json; scalar windows [49000,49999] unless explicitly final checkpoint
causal_effect_of_module: NOT_IDENTIFIED: no same-geometry outcome-off run or shared-distribution held-out evaluation
termination_metric_caveat: Episode_Termination scalars average the last stored termination type over environments, then over rollout logging; they are not pooled newly terminated-episode frequencies.
metric_caveat: Recovered-serve and kick-proxy shares have separate numerators; neither is strict per-ball joint success. Final speed ceiling is sampling distribution, not established skill.
mechanism_limit: Auxiliary head optimizes shared visual encoder, not actor MLP or recovery reward; 0.16-s targets censor all done-crossing windows. Long-horizon recovery improvement is not directly supervised.
next_decisive_comparator: Train v3 geometry with outcome_aux_coef=0 using matched interaction budget; evaluate existing v2/v3 policies on a shared fixed distribution before attributing gain or harm.
